summary: Resume suspended OMP seats with matching authored transcript selectors

compatibility.detail: Strict OMP resume accepts an authored absolute transcript selector when its filename and header identify the recorded native session, including when a pinned resume path is present. Both paths must identify the recorded session; mismatches remain refused. agents start refuses currently declared held suspended seats with start-suspended and directs callers to agents resume instead of successfully publishing a declaration that cannot start. A prior agent declaration reconstructed from a stop is not a held seat: stop-then-start and restoration of stopped or retired mission, step and one-shot seats retain their existing behavior.

manual.detail: Use agents resume for an existing suspended seat; agents start does not lift a suspension.

recovery.detail: No migration or state rewrite is required.
